component.name: MonoCode
component.summary: Desktop interface for your coding agents

description.p: MonoCode Linux is a desktop app (Tauri + React) that puts coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Pi, omp, fx, Hermes Agent and MiniMax Code — in one interface. Tabs are sessions, the composer is the input, and each provider runs on its own subscription.
The Flatpak build runs the interface sandboxed and executes your shells, provider CLIs and git on the host, so install at least one provider CLI on the host before opening the app.
